messages:
sara (CS): Hey team — Nova Health is asking for a 90min enablement session next week to onboard their platform engineers + product owners. They want hands-on inference tuning + webhook setup. Looking for slot options and agenda suggestions.
omar_k: I can do Tue/Wed mornings PST. Prefer Wed 10am PST if possible.
jessie_lin: Wed 10am PST works for me. Recommend splitting into 60min engineers deep-dive + 30min product Q&A, or run two back-to-back sessions.
lia_m: +1 on split sessions. Engineers session should cover: model variant selection, batching config, KV prefix caching, and a short lab to push a sample model. Product session: rollout strategy, cost controls, and SLOs.
sara (CS): Good — Nova has folks in CET too (Ellen and Marco). Wed 10am PST = Wed 19:00 CET; that might be late. Do we want to offer two times or record?
omar_k: If attendees from CET are >2, offer a separate APAC/EU-friendly slot. Otherwise record+live Q&A next day. Recording is fine but they prefer live for hands-on.
jessie_lin: We could run engineers at 10am PST, then run a repeat at 8am PST (which is 17:00 CET) next day for EU participants. That keeps labs small.
sara (CS): Ok planner: 
- Option A: Wed 10am PST (eng deep-dive) + Wed 11:30am PST (product Q&A) — single day
- Option B: Wed 10am PST (eng) + Thu 8am PST (eng repeat for EU) + Wed 11:30am PST (product Q&A)
I'll send a short Doodle and proposed agenda. Any blockers?
lia_m: Need a demo repo and a short dataset from Nova — ask them to share a small inference payload and expected QPS. Also confirm access level: will they want Private deployment walkthrough?
enablement-bot: Reminder: book a conference room (Zoom + recording) and set "hands-on" label on the session in Enablement Calendar.
sara (CS): I'll message Nova for payload + QPS and suggest Option B as preferred. Assigning action items: sara -> confirm data/sample; jessie -> prepare lab steps + repo link; omar -> prepare slide deck on batching/caching; lia -> draft product playbook and rollout checklist. Targeting invites by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
